name: tr_battle
caption:
IF JAMISON BATTLE HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🏹 Decidueye: fires arrow quills from its wings, and its shots never miss. 89 threes as a George Washington freshman, a school record
🐟 Magikarp: called the weakest Pokémon, but it survives anywhere. Undrafted in 2024, we signed him anyway
💦 Blastoise: the water cannons on its shell are pinpoint accurate. 24 points at New Orleans, 6-of-8 from three
🐲 Bagon: dreams of flying, so it leaps off cliffs every day. From a two-way deal to a standard 3-year contract
❄️ Froslass: freezes its foes with icy breath. 14 points, all in the 4th quarter, no misses, in our playoff win over Cleveland
🐉 Gyarados: what Magikarp evolves into, and its rampages don't stop. 42.1% from three through 9 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Jamison Battle had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF BATTLE HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Decidueye. It fires arrow quills from its wings, and its shots never miss. As a George Washington freshman: eighty-nine threes, a school record.
beats.dlg: ITS ARROWS NEVER MISS.|89 THREES, A SCHOOL RECORD

beats.vo: Magikarp. Everyone calls it the weakest Pokemon, but it survives anywhere. Undrafted in twenty twenty-four. We signed him anyway.
beats.dlg: CALLED WEAK. IT SURVIVES.|UNDRAFTED IN 2024. SIGNED!

beats.vo: Blastoise. The water cannons on its shell are pinpoint accurate. Twenty-four points at New Orleans, six of eight from three.
beats.dlg: PINPOINT WATER CANNONS.|24 POINTS, 6 OF 8 FROM 3!

beats.vo: Bagon. It dreams of flying, so it leaps off cliffs every day. From a two-way contract to a full three-year deal.
beats.dlg: IT DREAMS OF FLYING.|TWO-WAY TO A 3-YEAR DEAL!

beats.vo: Froslass. It freezes its foes with icy breath. Playoffs, Game three against Cleveland: fourteen points, all in the fourth, no misses.
beats.dlg: IT FREEZES ITS FOES.|14 IN THE 4TH, NO MISSES

beats.vo: And the ace. Gyarados. Magikarp evolves into this, and once it rampages, it doesn't stop. Forty-two point one percent from three through nine games.
That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Freshman at George Washington: program single-season record 89 three-pointers; undrafted in the 2024 NBA draft, signed by Toronto July 16, 2024, converted to a two-way contract; November 27: career-high 24 points, 6-of-8 three-pointers, road win at New Orleans; February 7, 2025: converted into a standard three-year (3-year) contract; April 23, 2026, Game 3 of the first round vs Cleveland: 14 points, all in the fourth (4th) quarter, perfect shooting, 126-104 win
